weighting: Within each dose/context metric, each paper contributes 1/J; its retained comparisons share that weight equally. Endpoint-specific metrics further stratify by endpoint.
summary: Use a reported cohort mean when single; combine independent compatible subgroups by N; average repeated acquisitions with cohort N counted once. No pooling across doses, endpoints or gas contexts.
figure_selection: A–C: healthy adults, source-supported or explicitly assumed, exact pure HC. D: those pure-HC records plus every eligible exact mixed-HC record in healthy adults.
adult_rule: Source-supported: minimum age ≥18 or explicit adult designation. Analytically assumed adult cohorts are separately labelled healthy_adults_assumed; the assumption does not establish published age evidence.
headline: Global panel C (pure HC) and D (pure plus mixed HC) metrics score each representation and direction separately. Each paper has equal total influence across all its retained panel comparisons; doses, endpoints and contexts divide that paper weight. Dose/context metrics remain available.
legacy_keys: subject_weighted / within_paper_weighted / *_weighted remain stable machine identifiers for Study summary; they do not specify across-paper weighting.
